svg.aria-label: One custom element: <synthwerk-chat> renders into an open shadow root. Host CSS and widget CSS do not mix. Desktop and mobile: Launcher and panel on desktop, full-screen sheet on small screens. Streamed answers: The answer streams in as safe Markdown. Raw HTML stays text. Signed-in users only: Signed-out visitors see a sign-in prompt. The widget then sends no request
